entries.title: Merge requests and pipeline checks on GitLab
entries.body: Work on your projects on gitlab.com or your own GitLab server now merges through merge requests. A crewmate opens a merge request for its work, the card shows GitLab's pipeline as the checks, and your merge click merges exactly the version those checks passed. A pipeline that is still running or failed, or a manual job nobody started, holds the merge.

picture.alt: A completion card for a GitLab project naming its merge request !1, with the checks passed and the button to merge it
